name: Quiz Buzzer
tagline: No account, no class code. One invite, and every phone is a buzzer.
description:
No account. No class code. No quiz company. The questions live in the file, it works on a plane, and one invite is the room.

Put a question on the big screen. Everyone else gets four huge coloured answers filling their phone. First correct answer scores. Wrong and late are recorded honestly. When everyone is in, the answer lights up. Next. At the end, the board.

On your own, drill the bundled pack against the clock — forty original questions in science, geography, words and numbers. Nothing is fetched.

Want a question that is not in the pack? Type it, pick four answers, tap which is right. It stays in this file, so the quiz you made travels with the GIF.
